topic: Asking the Home Store Staff to Help Measure Curtains

script.title: MEASURING THE CURTAINS
script.scene_zh: 家居店 · 量窗簾尺寸
script.story_hook: The old curtains come down, the new ones wait.
script.intro_zh: 舊窗簾卸下了，新窗簾還在等一個尺寸。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's home store visit. Listen for smart measuring phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的家居店場景。留意量尺寸的好用說法。
script.outro: That's a window measured, styled, and sorted. Listen again, repeat every line.
script.outro_zh: 一扇窗就這樣量好、選好、安排好。再聽一次，逐句大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: my living room is a cloud
script.char_a_description: a woman in her sixties with short white hair, a soft lavender cardigan over a floral blouse, beige trousers, a small tape measure on her wrist loop, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a man in his early thirties with tight dark curls shaved short on the sides, a rust orange corduroy vest over a chambray shirt, a yellow tape measure around his neck, and a broad-shouldered build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you measure windows here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi du ju ˈmɛʒɚ ˈwɪnˌdoʊz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問你們這裡會幫人量窗簾尺寸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, it's my favorite kind of math.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚət kaɪnd əv mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 會的，那是我最喜歡的一種數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, my old curtain rod finally gave up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ oʊld ˈkɝtən ɹɑd ˈfaɪnəli ɡeɪv ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我家舊窗簾桿終於撐不住，塌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic Monday surprise, brand new project?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk ˈmʌnˌdeɪ sɚˈpɹaɪz brænd nu ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 經典的週一驚喜，要全部換新嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the living room, two big hungry windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ɹum tu bɪɡ ˈhʌŋɡɹi ˈwɪnˌdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 對，客廳有兩扇很大的窗，陽光特別貪心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hungry windows, I love that phrase.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌŋɡɹi ˈwɪnˌdoʊz aɪ lʌv ðæt fɹeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 貪心的窗，我很愛這種說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what do you need from me first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt du ju nid fɹʌm mi fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 那你需要我先給你什麼資訊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand here, I'll measure the width, hold still.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd hɪɹ aɪl ˈmɛʒɚ ðə wɪdθ hoʊld stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 請站在這裡，我先量寬度，先別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, it tickles, that tape is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ɪt ˈtɪkəlz ðæt teɪp ɪz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，好癢，那條捲尺冰冰涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, but did you measure at home first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi bʌt dɪd ju ˈmɛʒɚ æt hoʊm fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我們先確認一下：你在家量過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-two inches, should the rod go wider?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti tu ˈɪntʃəz ʃʊd ðə ɹɑd ɡoʊ ˈwaɪdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六十二英寸，那窗簾桿要再長一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, add six inches, curtains need air.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æd sɪks ˈɪntʃəz ˈkɝtənz nid ɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，再加六英寸，窗簾需要透氣的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curtains need air, noted, you're poetic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɝtənz nid ɛɹ ˈnoʊɾɪd jʊɹz poʊˈɛɾɪk/
dialogue.zh: 「窗簾需要透氣」，我記下了，你真有詩意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, now the drop, floor or puddle length?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ naʊ ðə dɹɑp floɹ ɔɹ ˈpʌdəl lɛŋθ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，接下來是垂下的長度，要落地還是拖地？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's puddle length, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ˈpʌdəl lɛŋθ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 「拖地」到底是多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fabric pools three inches on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæbɹɪk pʊlz θɹi ˈɪntʃəz ɑn ðə floɹ/
dialogue.zh: 布料會在地板上多堆出三英寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my mop would fight that fabric.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ maɪ mɑp wʊd faɪt ðæt ˈfæbɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 噢不行，我的拖把會跟那塊布吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then floor length, one inch off the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn floɹ lɛŋθ wʌn ɪntʃ ɔf ðə ɡɹaʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 那就落地長，離地一英寸剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, drop me a number for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt dɹɑp mi ə ˈnʌmbɚ fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那個長度請給我一個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety inches, floor length, from the rod.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnɾi ˈɪnˌtʃɪz floɹ lɛŋθ fɹʌm ðə ɹɑd/
dialogue.zh: 從窗簾桿量到地面，九十英寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety, wow, those are serious curtains.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnɾi waʊ ðoʊz ɑɹ ˈsɪɹiəs ˈkɝtənz/
dialogue.zh: 九十英寸，哇，這窗簾真氣派。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Serious windows deserve serious fabric.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɹiəs ˈwɪnˌdoʊz dɪˈzɝv ˈsɪɹiəs ˈfæbɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 講究的窗，就得配講究的布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, how many panels per window, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpænəlz pɚ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那每扇窗要幾片簾呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two panels per window, four pieces total.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpænəlz pɚ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ fɔɹ ˈpiˌsɛz ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 每扇窗兩片，四片剛好湊齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, and do they overlap when closed?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ænd du ðeɪ ˌoʊvɚˈlæp wɛn kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 四片，關起來的時候會重疊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They meet nicely, pleats hide the seam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ mit ˈnaɪsli plits haɪd ðə sim/
dialogue.zh: 會溫柔地合攏，褶子剛好藏住縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pleated, hmm, or flat and simple?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɪɾɪt həm ɔɹ flæt ænd ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 打褶……嗯，還是平整簡約的款式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat shows the fabric, pleated feels cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ʃoʊz ðə ˈfæbɹɪk ˈplɪɾɪd filz ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 平整款看得出布的質感，打褶款更溫馨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cozy wins, my living room is a cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊzi wɪnz maɪ ˈlɪvɪŋ ɹum ɪz ə ˈklaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那就選溫馨，我的客廳就是一朵雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cloud with hungry windows, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə klaʊd wɪð ˈhʌŋɡɹi ˈwɪnˌdoʊz ˈpɝfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 一朵帶著貪心窗戶的雲，太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, and I saw fabric shears by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ænd aɪ sɔ ˈfæbɹɪk ʃɪɹz baɪ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我進門時看到旁邊有裁布的大剪刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great ones, nine dollars, they glide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wʌnz naɪn ˈdɑləɹz ðeɪ ɡlaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那組很棒，九美元，剪起來滑溜溜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need shears, or do you cut here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ʃɪɹz ɔɹ du ju kʌt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要自己拿剪刀，還是你們這裡能裁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hem for you, six dollars a panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hɛm fɔɹ ju sɪks ˈdɑləɹz ə ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 我們能幫你縫好邊，一片六美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six times four, that's twenty-four dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks taɪmz fɔɹ ðæts ˈtwɛnɾi fɔɹ ˈdɑləɹz/
dialogue.zh: 六乘四，就是二十四美元，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and four fresh hems beat frayed edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ænd fɔɹ fɹɛʃ hɛmz bit fɹeɪd ˈɛdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，四道整齊的新邊，勝過毛邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, you sew, I'll bring the coffee next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /sold ju soʊ aɪl brɪŋ ðə ˈkɔfi nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 成交，你負責縫，下次我帶咖啡來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll hold the ladder, you bring sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl hoʊld ðə ˈlæɾɚ ju brɪŋ ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我幫你扶梯子，你帶糖來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking of ladders, my rod is bent, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspikɪŋ ʌv ˈlæɾɚz maɪ ɹɑd ɪz bɛnt ʊps/
dialogue.zh: 說到梯子，我的舊窗簾桿其實歪了，糟糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bent rod, new project, that explains it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnt ɹɑd nu ˈpɹɑdʒɛkt ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 桿子歪了，又要全部換新，難怪呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, guilty, does that change the length math?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈɡɪɾɪ dʌz ðæt tʃeɪndʒ ðə lɛŋθ mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，瞞不過你，這會影響長度的計算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not much, new rods sit two inches higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt mʌtʃ nu ɹɑdz sɪt tu ˈɪnˌtʃəz ˈhaɪɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 影響不大，新桿會高出兩英寸而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, do you sell rods here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd du ju sɛl ɹɑdz hɪɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那就好，你們這裡也賣窗簾桿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, aluminum or wood, both strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du əˈluməˌnəm ɔɹ wʊd boʊθ stɹɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，鋁製和木製兩種，都很結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wood, it matches a cloud, you think fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt ˈmætʃəz ə ˈklaʊd ju θɪŋk fæst/
dialogue.zh: 木頭的，跟雲很相配，你反應真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixteen dollars each, ninety-six inches long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɪksˈtin ˈdɑləɹz itʃ ˌnaɪnɾi ˈsɪks ˈɪnˌtʃəz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一根十六美元，長度九十六英寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that cover the whole window then?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt ˈkʌvɚ ðə hoʊl ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那這樣整扇窗都遮得住了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, plus brackets, five bucks more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz plʌs ˈbɹækəts faɪv bʌks mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 遮得住，再加上支架，多五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wallet sighs, but beauty costs, I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwʌlət saɪz bʌt ˈbjuti kɔsts aɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的錢包輕輕一嘆，可是美麗要有代價，我明白。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, philosopher with tape measures, my people.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fəˈlɑsəfɚ wɪð teɪp ˈmɛʒɚz maɪ ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，帶著捲尺的哲學家，真是我的同路人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, when can all this be ready, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn kən ɔl ðɪs bi ˈɹɛdi ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 那這些大概何時能全部準備好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hems take two weeks, rods are in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛmz teɪk tu wɪks ɹɑdz ɑɹ ɪn stɑk/
dialogue.zh: 縫邊要兩週，桿子現貨就能拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, right before the rain, perfect timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wɪks ɹaɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ɹeɪn ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 兩週，正好趕在雨季前，時間太剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note your number, text when they're pressed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ tɛkst wɛn ðɛɹ pɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我記錄你的電話，窗簾整燙好就傳訊息通知你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, can I buy the shears today?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm kən aɪ baɪ ðə ʃɪɹz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，那我可以今天先把剪刀買起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, they'll save you a crooked hem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ðeɪl seɪv ju ə ˈkɹʊkɪd hɛm/
dialogue.zh: 當然，它們能幫你避開縫歪的邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, shears, four panels, two straight rods.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ʃɪɹz fɔɹ ˈpænəlz tu stɹeɪt ɹɑdz/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，剪刀、四片窗簾，外加兩根筆直的新桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the whole dream, total two forty-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə hoʊl dɹim ˈtoʊɾəl tu ˈfɔɹɾi naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那就是一整套的美夢，總共兩百四十九美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth every inch, can I pay by card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜɹθ ˈɛvɹi ɪntʃ kən aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 每一英寸都值得，可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap here, next stop, your bedroom windows, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp hɪɹ nɛkst stɑp jɔɹ ˈbɛdˌɹum ˈwɪnˌdoʊz baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡感應就好，下一站，你臥室的窗簾，再見！

script.youtube_description:
「我的客廳就是一朵雲」——窗簾桿塌了，走進家居店，該怎麼請店員幫你量尺寸？本集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在窗簾區的展示窗前。

你會聽到：量寬度與垂墜長度的完整說法、落地與拖地的差別、要幾片簾、打褶還是平整、代客縫邊的計價，還有歪掉的窗簾桿如何影響計算，以及裁布剪刀與取貨時間。整段只用 A2 初級單字，搭配美國人自然的語感：um、so、ha、hmm、wow。

聽完你就會用：Do you measure...、How many panels、Six dollars a panel、When can all this be ready。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱，開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My living room is a cloud" — the curtain rod gave up, and now you stand in a home store facing a wall of fabric. This 60-line immersive English listening practice happens right in the curtain aisle.

You will hear: measuring width and drop, floor length versus puddle length, how many panels per window, pleated versus flat, the hem service price, a bent rod, fabric shears, pickup timing, and paying by card.

Everything stays in A2 words with the natural American texture: um, so, ha, hmm, wow. By the end you'll own lines like Do you measure windows and When can all this be ready.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
窗簾桿在週一晚上突然塌了，隔天你站在家居店的布牆前，該從哪裡問起？寬度、垂下長度、要幾片簾，到底差在哪？縫邊的錢又怎麼算？

這一集帶大家走進家居店的窗簾區，從請店家量尺寸、挑落地或拖地，一路聽到打褶與平整、代客縫邊、裁布剪刀、歪掉的窗簾桿與取貨時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📏 量尺寸：Stand here, I'll measure the width, hold still.
🪄 選長度：Ha, now the drop, floor or puddle length?
🧵 縫邊：We hem for you, six dollars a panel.
🛠️ 換桿：Bent rod, new project, that explains it.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著捲尺走一趟家居店，下次再面對一整面布牆，你也能淡定開口問。

祝你家裡的窗，往後都有一朵剛好的雲。
